decisions.reason: As a high-resolution piezo inkjet printer, it builds directly on the firm's core in-house marking and inkjet expertise, so the firm can readily assimilate and improve it.

The numbering software module extends the firm's existing software portfolio for variable-data inline printing, aligning with its digitalization and traceability trajectory and drawing on related knowledge.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces leverages the firm's strong ink and substrate know-how, making early results interpretable and improvements feasible.
Though a mobile app is less central than hardware, it succeeds the firm's earlier PharmaScan app, providing prior related knowledge that supports learning and integration into traceability offerings.

An inline code verification system complements the firm's marking solutions but requires some machine-vision capabilities; still, its closeness to code quality and compliance allows the firm to interpret results and improve it.
Print layout design software builds on the firm's existing software and printer-operation knowledge, supporting one-stop user experience and hence is likely to be retained.
